title: Runtime attention compatibility layer and sample-driven tuning for graceful FlashAttention v2->v3 migration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a lightweight compatibility shim and sample-driven parameter tuner to enable safe, progressive rollout of FlashAttention v3 variants across production clusters without regressing p99 latency or correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility shim routes requests to v2 or v3 deterministically based on request fingerprint and rollout percentage
Telemetry shows no >5% increase in p99 latency or >1% increase in token error / decode mismatch after 2-week canary at 20% traffic
Automated perf tests (long-context and short-context) included in CI and pass against v3 with quantized profiles
Rollback path and automation exist: feature flag toggles routing and drains v3 pools within 60s
Documentation and runbook for on-call to diagnose v2/v3 mismatches published in Confluence
implementation_notes: Shim design: in-memory kernel selector that overlays current heuristic and pins decisions with a persisted sample map for deterministic routing
Sampler: lightweight request sampler (0.5% by default) that records shape, seq_len, token_type, and observed latency/ooms into telemetry stream
Tuner: offline job consumes sampler data to recommend preferred kernel (v2/v3) by shape and temperature buckets and emits policy diff
Compatibility checks: token-level decode checksum on a sampled subset (1/10k requests) to detect precision/regression deltas
Backoff strategy: if observed p99 increases or checksum mismatches exceed threshold, auto-decrease v3 rollout by 50% and notify on-call
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (internal): run shim in dry-run for 2 days on staging; collect sampler and checksum telemetry
Stage 1 (canary): enable deterministic 5% traffic to v3 across two lower-latency clusters for 48 hours
Stage 2 (scaled canary): ramp to 20% in a single region for 7 days, monitor p50/p95/p99 and checksum mismatch rate
Stage 3 (wider roll): 50% across regions with automated tuner recommendations applied; hold for 72 hours
Stage 4: full roll with continuous monitoring and weekly tuner recommendations
